content:
Unclear as of yet. But with the news of widespread outages, there are certainly questions. Following last week’s nationwide flight shutdown and Microsoft outages, there are now reports of major tech issues affecting companies like United Airlines and Apple, as well as several big banks, including Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America. And apparently the National Security Agency’s system for communicating highly classified information is down too.

Amid all this unnerving news, social media platforms like Threads and X are fortunately still going strong, so at least we can all joke about our apparent demise. Keep scrolling for some hilarious posts about the mysterious outages of late.
